body.text: Embeds the `internal` template as a generated string constant (`make codegen-template`) instead of reading it from `priv`, and drops `gleam_erlang`, so the CLI runs on JavaScript as well as Erlang. This is step 1 of the TypeScript target plan. Generated output is byte-identical; a bun bundle of the CLI was checked against the Erlang output locally but is not part of this change.

title.text: feat(atproto_codegen): run the CLI on the JavaScript target
